title: Geekvape Aegis Hero 5 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Aegis Hero 5 is a compact, tough pod-mod built for exceptional performance and everyday reliability. A 2000mAh built-in battery delivers an adjustable 5–50W output, while Smart Mode can set a suitable wattage for your coil automatically. Prefer full control? Switch to Variable Wattage and dial in your own setting. You can vape using the fire button or by simple inhale activation. Airflow is adjusted at the top of the pod to help resist leaks and to let you tailor the draw from mouth-to-lung (MTL) through restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) and full DTL. The 2ml top-fill pod uses the proven Geek Vape B Series push-fit coils; in the box you’ll find 0.4ohm (best around 25–30W) for RDL and 0.2ohm (best around 50–58W) for DTL. A 0.96” TFT screen presents key information clearly, and Geek Vape’s A-Lock switch helps prevent accidental firing when you’re on the move. The IP68 “Tri-proof” design provides water, dust and shock resistance in a pocketable chassis. For best results, use 70% VG e-liquid with the supplied 0.2ohm and 0.4ohm coils. If you prefer a tighter MTL vape with 50/50 e-liquid, the wider B Series range offers higher-resistance options (sold separately). Colours: Iron Black, Blaze Red, Pure White, Steel Silver, Racing Green, Turbo Blue, Frost Mint. Explore our vape juice uk and discover a delicious companion for this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
